_comment: EDIT THIS when a new bumper is announced. Set announced:true, drawDateISO in IST (+05:30), and all other fields from the official notification (bumper prize structures vary edition to edition — do not assume the previous bumper's amounts or tier count still apply; some editions have no 9th Prize tier). While no bumper is confirmed, keep announced:false and no other fields — do not invent a name, date, code or prize. After the draw, its result flows into results.json via the scraper and shows under Past Bumpers automatically — then set this back to announced:false until the next one is confirmed.
